listen_address.description: IP address on which postgrey listens for incoming SMTP connections from Postfix. Usually localhost.

listen_port.description: TCP port number for postgrey to bind to. Default Postfix port for greylisting is 10023.

run_as_user.description: System user account to run the postgrey daemon under. Should have read/write access to the database file.

run_as_group.description: Optional system group to run the daemon under. If empty, uses the primary group of `run_as_user`.

db_path.description: Path to the database file used for storing greylisting records. SQLite is used by default.

db_engine.description: Database engine: 'sqlite', 'mysql', or 'postgres'. SQLite is standard for most Postfix setups.

whitelist_clients_delay.description: Time (in seconds) before greylisting is skipped for whitelisted clients. Set to 0 to skip greylisting entirely for them.

whitelist_recipients_delay.description: Time (in seconds) before greylisting is skipped for whitelisted recipients. Set to 0 to disable greylisting for them.

whitelist_clients.description: List of IPs, CIDR ranges, or hostnames to whitelist from greylisting.

whitelist_sender_domains.description: List of sender domains (exact or regex) to whitelist.

whitelist_sender_addresses.description: List of exact sender email addresses or patterns to whitelist.

whitelist_recipient_domains.description: List of recipient domains to whitelist.

whitelist_recipient_addresses.description: List of exact recipient email addresses to whitelist.

syslog.description: If true, log to system syslog. If false, log to file instead.

log_file.description: Path to log file when syslog is disabled. Ignored if syslog is enabled.

loglevel.description: Verbosity level: 0 (quiet), 1 (normal), 2 (verbose). Set higher if troubleshooting.

greylist_seconds.description: Minimum seconds to wait before accepting mail from a new sender. Typical value: 300 (5 minutes).

greylist_max_age.description: Maximum seconds after which greylisting records expire (i.e., after how long a sender must re-greylist).

whitelist_postfix_smtpd.description: If true, skip greylisting for mail submitted via postfix local smtpd.

postgrey_text.description: Custom greylist rejection message text. Used only if set (non-empty).
